1. Vakalatanama filed by Shri Mohd. Yasir Abbasi, Advocate on behalf of National Highways
Authority of India (Nhai) is taken on record.
2. Heard counsel for the parties.

3. Learned counsel for the State informs the Court that accounts of the petitioners have been defreezed on the orders of Special Land Acquisition Officer, who is the competent authority under the NHAI, Act, 1956.
As regards, compensation she informs that the compensation has been paid to Jageshwar-opposite party no.8 herein who has filed the connected writ petition.
There is a short counter affidavit to this effect in the connected writ petition filed by Jageshwar.
4. Counsel for the Bank also states that account of the petitioners Malti Devi and Ahibaran have been defreezed.

Whether the petitioners Malti Devi and Ahibaran have incorrectly been paid the compensation for the land acquired which has now been paid to Jageshwar is an issue which can be seen by the competent authority under the National Highways Authority Act.
If the NHAI has any grievance in this matter, it can approach the competent authority who may resolve the matter.

5. As regards, the claim of Jageshwar, the petitioner in the connected writ petition, who is represented by Shri Shyamendra Singh, that he has not been paid the entire compensation, let the competent authority look into this aspect of the matter also on an application to be submitted by the petitioner and take a decision accordingly whosoever is the rightful owner should be paid compensation fully and if any compensation has been paid to a person not entitled then appropriate proceedings can be drawn for recovery of the same as per law.
Let this exercise be completed at the earliest.
6. Both the writ petitions are disposed of.

Order Date :- 7.1.2025 Pks [Brij Raj Singh,J.] [Rajan Roy, J.]
